Description:

[u][b]Compatibility[/b][/u]:
Not compatible with mods that alter barns and coops (Barn1/2/3.xnb and Coop1/2/3.xnb).
Compatible with mods altering spritesheets used by those maps.

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]: (Just look at the images instead.)
[list]
[*]Repaired all broken boards. (Not trying to point fingers but someone did a terrible job... [i]*Twas Robin[/i])
[*]Made more symmetrical.
[*]Removed all clutter.
[/list]"[i]What have you done! Map is too empty! You removed all the pretty details![/i]" - I know, main purpose of this mod is to allow players to decorate their buildable spaces as they want whether they use furniture or machines. (FACTORY MUST GROW... I mean sorry, wrong game...)

[i]I'm planning on making this a series of mods. I'm planning to edit the cellar, greenhouse, farm buildings, and other farms. Maybe even the farmhouse interior itself (I took a look and was horrified by what a jigsaw mess it is... So maybe later). Later I will make matching banners and make this site prettier.
[/i]
If I overlooked some sprites, let me know (nature cut in half, wrong sprites, etc.).
